note: The single canonical parameter sheet. docs/parameters.csv, programs/solbeam/src/params.rs and tests/params.json are all generated from this file by config/gen.py.

code_constants.name: MAX_SCRIPT_LEN
code_constants.description: The length of the 2-of-2 deposit script `fed.script` describes, asserted against that row's own text.

parameters.name: Window length (hours)
parameters.description: How much BSV history the client keeps. Sets the deposit deadline

parameters.name: Window length (records)
parameters.description: window_hours × 3600 / seconds_per_block. Bounded above by the account cap

parameters.name: Target block spacing
parameters.description: BSV's ten-minute target

parameters.name: Bytes per header record
parameters.description: 32 hash + 16 chainwork + 4 time. Not configurable

parameters.name: DAA lookback (records)
parameters.description: 144 + 3 for the median-of-three. Measured: 146 reproduces 0/324 headers, 147 reproduces 324/324

parameters.name: Difficulty rule
parameters.description: The rule BSV actually uses. Verified against real mainnet headers. Hard-coded (X3)

parameters.name: Lower clamp
parameters.description: Multiplies seconds_per_block, not the averaging window

parameters.name: Upper clamp
parameters.description: As above

parameters.name: Confirmation depth
parameters.description: MIN_CONFIRMATIONS, fixed in code, not a runtime parameter

parameters.name: Headers per fork tx
parameters.description: Set by the 1,232-byte transaction limit

parameters.name: Solana account cap
parameters.description: A Solana limit, not a choice

parameters.name: Deployment identifier
parameters.description: Binds a deposit to one deployment (P11). Must differ per cluster. Not built — the code checks only that the recipient's 32 bytes appear in the OP_RETURN

parameters.name: Maximum target
parameters.description: Regtest uses 0x207fffff; mainnet 0x1d00ffff. In code as MAINNET_POW_LIMIT_BITS, with no_retargeting derived from the regtest value

parameters.name: Freshness bound
parameters.description: How recent the last accepted header must be before release. A multiple of BSV block time — ~1,500 Solana slots per block. Implemented (StaleClient), untested on a local validator

parameters.name: Maturity
parameters.description: Staged mints wait this long before release. A stored parameter, not a constant, so governance can raise it without a redeploy. At 0 the vault is a pass-through and release/burn are a race. The designed value is 144 blocks

parameters.name: Detection margin
parameters.description: window − maturity. Do not add floor into this subtraction. Zero at the maximum committed depth
parameters.csv_value: 48 blocks at the designed values der

parameters.name: Rent refund on close
parameters.description: Closing an item returns its rent to the caller

parameters.name: Mint-side bond — BSV side (the float)
parameters.description: Held outside the reserve. The bond is the float — working capital for transfers — not a capital requirement sized against the reserve, and not a capacity ceiling. The k × (BSV held) line is a solvency check on mint and exit. Held under the collective (threshold ECDSA) key, not the member's own, and seized by the members collectively; slashing pays the slashers from it. A collective action by the majority, not an automatic rule

parameters.name: Mint-side bond custody
parameters.description: The design requirement the mechanism rests on. If a member controls their own bond they move it the moment they are caught. Residuals: a majority could seize an honest member's bond; nothing on BSV compels signing, so the duty to slash is social

parameters.name: Redeem-side bond — solBSV side (the float)
parameters.description: Seizable on Solana. This side is enforceable. Neither bond sits inside the reserve

parameters.name: Nominal bond size
parameters.description: Superseded by the two side-specific bonds; kept as the per-side default name

parameters.name: Aggregate bond (tracked)
parameters.description: The old single running total is replaced by two side-specific aggregates

parameters.name: Bonds gate minting
parameters.description: F5. A mint is refused unless the BSV-side bond covers the BSV held after it. A solvency floor, not a capacity claim. The old total_bond ≥ k × (non_bonded_supply + amount) is superseded

parameters.name: Bond denomination
parameters.description: Mint side BSV, redeem side solBSV; neither inside the reserve. No price oracle is needed for either

parameters.name: Against a colluding threshold
parameters.description: Stated risk, not a mechanism. No on-chain predicate proves who signed an off-chain threshold signature. The maximum loss is the whole non-member supply. Publishing the reserve and supply converts a hidden theft into a visible one; the unchallenged-spend case is separately addressed by the reported spent-outpoint record

parameters.name: Bond coverage floor
parameters.description: bsv_bond ≥ k × (BSV held) and solbsv_bond ≥ k × (solBSV held), checked on mint and exit. A solvency check, not a capacity ceiling. The capacity arithmetic built on k and n/t is withdrawn. Capital inefficiency accepted

parameters.name: Gateway signing threshold
parameters.description: t of n for the gateway threshold ECDSA key. N is a variable; the number is arbitrary and deferred. The key emits one signature and is one leg of the reserve's 2-of-2 script. Changing t or n is a re-sharing, not a migration

parameters.name: Greycore size
parameters.description: The second signer set on the reserve script: trusted third parties, not node operators — people with reputations to lose, who do not run the reserve. The Greycore finds and admits replacement members

parameters.name: Greycore threshold
parameters.description: How many Greycore keys must sign alongside the gateway. The Greycore co-signs every reserve spend, which is what constrains the reserve. 4-of-5 was an earlier proposal and is not settled

parameters.name: Shard count
parameters.description: One key or several groups. Affects blast radius and latency. There is no sharding today: blast radius is 100%

parameters.name: Unbonding period
parameters.description: Must exceed the redemption deadline plus the challenge window

parameters.name: Delegated staking
parameters.description: Phase 2. Lets non-members delegate solBSV to a member and share its fee. Activatable by governance, not built

parameters.name: Reserve deposit script
parameters.description: OP_2 <gateway threshold key> <greycore key> OP_2 OP_CHECKMULTISIG. Both keys must sign; the Greycore polices every reserve spend. The committed code accepts this shape: is_reserve_multisig, MAX_SCRIPT_LEN = 71, DepositScript::SPACE = 84. The keys/quorum behind it are not built
parameters.csv_value: 2-of-2 OP_CHECKMULTISIG dec, shape accepted in code built

parameters.name: BSV-side bond seizure
parameters.description: The Solana program cannot seize the BSV-side bond; the members sign a threshold transaction. Stated as a residual, not hidden

parameters.name: Spent-outpoint record (N5)
parameters.value: one PDA per (txid, vout), written by the program authority built
parameters.description: report_spent records a deposit outpoint the reserve has spent; verify_deposit refuses a deposit whose outpoint is in the record. The signer is the upgrade authority — a PoC stand-in for the federation, which does not exist yet. Permanent and rent-exempt with no prune: closing a record would re-open the mint of an already-spent deposit
parameters.csv_value: one PDA per (txid, vout), written by the program authority built

parameters.name: Pass threshold
parameters.description: Share of pledged coins required

parameters.name: Delay before effect
parameters.description: Reducible by governance, but never below gov.delay_min. Redemptions run throughout

parameters.name: Minimum delay (floor)
parameters.description: F7. Both readings are defensible and the choice is open: with a floor, a majority cannot take the warning away — proposal 1 can only shorten the delay to the floor, so proposal 2 still has to be exited during it; without, the exit window is whatever the current majority allows. A judgement about trust, not a correctness question

parameters.name: Signal from proposal
parameters.description: Live from the moment it is raised

parameters.name: Governance owns the upgrade key
parameters.description: Deliberate. Nothing is immutable, so the exit window, not the rule, is the protection

parameters.name: Checkpoint/pause authority
parameters.value: federation threshold designed — in code it is the upgrade authority, one key, timelocked
parameters.description: F4. Replaces the single deployer key. No timelock-free path to rewriting the checkpoint. Not built
parameters.csv_value: federation threshold designed — in code it is the upgrade authority, one key, timelocked

parameters.name: Authority timelock
parameters.description: TIMELOCK_SLOTS, a PoC value. Applied to propose_authority_change / execute_authority_change / cancel_authority_change. Must be long enough to exit

parameters.name: Pause threshold
parameters.description: Lower than a governance change, because the power is bounded

parameters.name: Pause auto-lift
parameters.description: Days before a pause lapses unless renewed

parameters.name: Peg-in fee (gross)
parameters.description: Covers all transaction fees; the remainder is member income. Its physical location is unspecified — N1

parameters.name: Peg-out fee (gross)
parameters.description: As above

parameters.name: Challenger bounty
parameters.description: Share of a slashed bond paid to whoever proves the misbehaviour. The burn_staged bounty is suggested, not sized, and not built

parameters.name: Minimum deposit
parameters.description: Prices out dust griefing. Decided; enforcement is not in code

parameters.name: Legacy replay-list cap
parameters.description: Replaced by a nullifier PDA per deposit, which is built. There is no list and no ceiling

parameters.name: Deposit commitment
parameters.description: Designed. What is built checks only that the recipient's 32 bytes appear in an OP_RETURN
parameters.csv_value: version ‖ cluster_id ‖ program_hash ‖ flags ‖ recipient dec

parameters.name: Payout depth
parameters.description: BSV confirmations before a payout is provable. C_payout

parameters.name: Challenge window
parameters.description: W. Confirmations a payout needs before settling

parameters.name: Redemption deadline
parameters.description: How long a member has to pay before the holder may cancel. In Solana SLOTS, because a height deadline would never expire if the header feed stalled. NOTE: the earlier claim that this must exceed payout_confirmations + challenge_window does NOT hold at these values (216,000 slots against 150 BSV blocks). The pay-and-refund race is closed structurally instead -- cancel_redeem is refused while a claim is live.

parameters.name: Cancellation grace
parameters.description: Cancellation is immediate on expiry. A grace period would only delay the exit

parameters.name: Minimum redemption
parameters.description: Minimum redemption, so a claim's proof is worth the transaction fees to settle

parameters.name: Concurrent redemption cap
parameters.description: Cap on concurrent pending redemptions, so the escrow cannot be used to make the program's per-instruction work unbounded

parameters.name: Solana rent
parameters.description: (bytes + 128) × 5,080. The 128-byte overhead is inside this rate. 6,960 is an older toolchain's constant and overstates by ~37%. Measured: solana rent 0 = 650,240 lamports; solana rent 165 = 1,488,440

parameters.name: Solana base fee
parameters.description: Per signature

parameters.name: Transaction size
parameters.description: Solana limit; drives lc.max_fork_batch
